verdict.rationale: Warp documents running many agents concurrently across repos or tasks. Warp Factories coordinates a fleet of cloud agents that turns many issues and tickets into pull requests, and GitHub material shows thousands of agents triaging issues. That is real fan-out across many items, but it is framed as parallel agent runs, not a documented bulk or batch operation over a selected set of items. Missing for 10: an explicit batch API or command for acting on many items at once, documented selection and fan-out semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
